notes: I changed the outside-regime rule from sinc (sin(x)/x) to plain sin(x): the observations at large |x| (e.g. 0.72 at 88.2, 2.13 at 90, 1.63 at 120, -1.62 at 104.5) have magnitudes ~0.5–2, far larger than sinc's ~0.01, and are consistent with a bounded oscillation. I also moved the boundary to ~3.05 based on E6 (large at 3.0, small at 3.1).
